value.rationale: Addresses the biologically meaningful exact boundary between strict extinction and persistence results in the parent model: whether critical populations survive, whether decline is exponential, and how dispersal density dependence changes the quantitative amplitude. The arbitrary-patch universal vector profile and explicit separate recruitment/emigration derivative contributions are not a mere renaming or single numerical instance. Local Ricker/Beverton-Holt critical expansions are classical but do not alone establish the stated global all-n nonlinear dispersal law.
